title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, FDE
Lead Agentic AI Offensive Security Engineer
description_html: Lead Agentic AI Offensive Security Engineer          This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.                    Who We Are:                               Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.                     Job Description:        HPE’s Cybersecurity team is seeking a Lead Agentic AI Engineer to design, enhance and support  the technical direction of our AI-Enabled Offensive  security organization. Using your expertise in offensive security, you will architect and deliver secure, reliable, production-grade agentic AI platforms. These platforms will accelerate and scale cybersecurity triage, investigation, detection engineering, response, and other complex workflows.    Primary Responsibilities    Own the reference architecture and engineering standards for production agentic AI systems.  Design reusable agent execution harnesses that separate AI reasoning and planning from deterministic execution.  Lead multi-agent workflows, state management, memory, tool calling, human-in-the-loop controls, and long-running processes.  Define model-agnostic interfaces supporting commercial, cloud-hosted, and open-weight models, including routing, fallback, and workload-based selection.  Architect retrieval, context, and memory services using technologies such as RAG, hybrid search, and vector databases.  Establish strategies for MCP servers, A2A protocols, APIs, tool registries, and enterprise integrations.  Define evaluation, observability, reliability, and security practices, including least privilege, sandboxing, authorization, secrets management, guardrails, auditability, and defenses against prompt injection, tool abuse, and data leakage.  Lead cross-functional architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and communicate technical tradeoffs to senior leadership.     Experience and Skills    Candidates should demonstrate deep expertise in at least three areas, with Agentic Systems & Harness Engineering required:  System Design & Architecture  Agentic Systems & Harness Engineering  Model-Agnostic AI & Context Engineering  Platform Engineering & Production Reliability  Evaluation, Security & AI Safety    Experience with cybersecurity automation, security operations, offensive security, adversary simulation, reusable agent platforms, open-weight inference, or frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, MITRE ATT&CK, and NIST AI RMF is preferred.  10+ years of experience in software, platform, distributed-systems, or AI engineering, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems.  Proven experience architecting and operating production LLM-powered or agentic systems across their full lifecycle.  Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, workflow and state management, scalability, concurrency, and fault tolerance.  Strong hands-on experience with agent orchestration, planning, tool calling, delegation, memory, and long-running workflows using LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent.  Experience with foundation-model APIs and open-weight or self-hosted models, structured generation, and function calling.  Expert Python and backend engineering skills, including REST/gRPC, messaging, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure.  Practical experience with agent evaluation, trajectory and regression testing, AI security, and production reliability.        Accessibility    HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked  here .    Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. Personal & Professional Development   We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.     Unconditional Inclusion   We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. title: P2 SRE and Platform Engineer - Sana Search (US Federal)
description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  Workday, founded in 2005, stands as a groundbreaking force in the human capital and financial management industry, with a global presence and a diverse array of customers. Across our offices worldwide, our teams are united by a shared dedication to innovation, collaboration, and excellence!  The Workday Sana Search Team is responsible for creating the world’s most powerful, platform-agnostic enterprise search product, transforming the way people and agents interact with knowledge, inside and outside the Workday ecosystem. We are in the process of building the definitive discovery platform: a standalone-ready, hybrid-by-design service that orchestrates enterprise data at scale. From federated gateways to agentic text retrieval pipelines and open personalization frameworks, we provide the blueprints for modern search, engineered for universal portability and precision.  Joining our team means embarking on a journey of opportunity to advance your career and contribute to impactful solutions that shape industries. Whether you thrive with solving sophisticated business problems, collaborating with agile teams, or championing innovation and software design, Workday offers an environment where your talents can thrive.    About the Role       This role will support one or more direct or indirect contracts with the U.S. Federal Government which, due to federal government security requirements, mandates that all Workday personnel working on the contracts be United States citizens (naturalized or native).        We are seeking a  DevOps & Platform Engineer (P2)  with  2+ years  of professional experience to join the Sana Search Team. In this role, you will support the day-to-day health, automation, and deployment of our cloud-native search products. Working alongside senior engineers, you will help automate processes, maintain CI/CD pipelines, and support our application teams in moving code smoothly from “commit” to “production”.        Federal Security Requirement:  This role supports one or more direct or indirect contracts with the U.S. Federal Government. Due to federal government security requirements, all personnel working on these contracts must be United States citizens (naturalized or native).      What you will do     Infrastructure & Platform Engineering      Infrastructure Provisioning: Assist in provisioning and updating AWS resources (EC2, Lambda, ElastiCache, S3, RDS) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.    Developer Enablement: Support self-service developer tooling and assist team members with local and production deployment workflows.    Containerization: Maintain Docker images and update Kubernetes manifests (using Kustomize or Helm) to support microservice deployments.    Operational Automation: Write and maintain scripts (Python/Go/Bash) to automate routine operational processes and configuration management tasks.      CI/CD & Deployment      Pipeline Support: Support, troubleshoot, and optimize existing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity, Argo CD) to keep build and deployment times fast and reliable.    Deployment Execution: Help execute and monitor routine deployments, identifying opportunities to automate manual steps.      Reliability & Observability      Monitoring & Alerting: Help build and maintain CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK dashboards to track system performance and health metrics.    Incident Support & Triage: Triage and debug production issues identified by monitoring tools. Assist in root-cause analysis and implementation of permanent fixes.    On-Call Rotation: Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain high availability for Sana Search.      Collaboration & Growth      Team Partnership: Collaborate directly with application developers to debug environment-specific issues and assist with performance troubleshooting.    Documentation: Create and maintain up-to-date documentation for deployment procedures, environment configurations, and runbooks.    Continuous Learning: Actively participate in team learning opportunities, guilds, and engineering reviews to grow technical capabilities.       About You      Basic Qualifications (Required)      Citizenship:  Must be a U.S. Citizen (required for Federal Government contract compliance).     Experience:  2+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Software Engineering roles.     Cloud & Linux:  Hands-on experience working with core AWS services (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and solid proficiency with Linux administration.     Containers & Orchestration:  Practical experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments.     IaC & CI/CD:  Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code frameworks (Terraform or CloudFormation) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, TeamCity, or Argo CD).     Programming/Scripting:  Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, or Bash).      Other Qualifications:      Compute : EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda     Storage : S3, EBS, EFS, RDS     Caching  : ElastiCache, File Cache     Networking  : VPC, App Mesh, Network Firewall     Control Plane  :CloudFormation, Terraform, AWS Organizations, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail     Infrastructure as Code  : CloudFormation, Terraform      Observability :  CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK(Solas) stack     CI/CD and Deployment : Jenkins and Teamcity, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD and Argo Workflow.     Containerization:  Docker, Kubernetes.    Possession of relevant cloud certifications is a plus, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Google Cloud Associate Engineer or similar.    Demonstrated ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable software build systems.    Experience in designing and implementing automated solutions for build, infrastructure, and software configuration management.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to new technologies.    Experience collaborating effectively with development and system architecture teams    Familiarity with implementing and adhering to Public Cloud best practices.        Workday Pay Transparency Statement      The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below.  Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please   click here  .      Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton    Primary Location Base Pay Range:  $110,200 USD - $165,200 USD    Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $92,400 USD - $165,200 USD    Our Approach to Flexible Work      With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply   spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field   with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
